text:
Alex Rivera: Heads-up — planning a short dual-write demo migration for user_profiles -> user_profiles_v2 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. This is a staging run but we'll exercise full smoke + rollback paths.
Priya Nair: cc @Sam Cho — you good to own smoke and rollback? :eyes:
Sam Cho: I can. I'll run the smoke checklist and watch metrics. What's the rollback mechanism?
Alex Rivera: Rollback plan: flip feature flag back to single-write + stop the backfill job (idempotent) + pg logical slot cleanup if needed. If feature flag flip fails, we have replica switchback and quick rehydrate plan.
Morgan Li: Add me on pager for the window. I'll keep an eye on tailing errors and replica lag.
Priya Nair: Can you paste the small SQL snippet we'll run to enable dual-write on app nodes so ops has it handy?
Alex Rivera: ```sql
-- enable dualwrite flag and start backfill
UPDATE feature_flags SET enabled = true WHERE name = 'user_profiles_dual_write';
SELECT start_backfill('user_profiles_v2');
```
Sam Cho: For validation I'll run: `select count(*) from user_profiles` vs `select count(*) from user_profiles_v2` and spot-check hashes for 1k random rows after ~10m. If mismatch > 0.5% we pause backfill.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging-db-migration at 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z (job id: db-7891).
ops-bot: Quick reminder: rollback playbook here https://redwood.internal/runbooks/db-dualwrite-rollback and alert thresholds doc https://redwood.internal/docs/alerts#replica-lag
Priya Nair: Ownership summary: Alex (lead), Sam (smoke + validation), Morgan (oncall/pager), Priya (rollback ops).
Alex Rivera: Final checklist before go: 1) confirm replica lag < 100ms, 2) set alert thresholds (err rate & lag), 3) smoke owner online, 4) canary at 5% traffic, 5) backfill paused on anomalies.
Sam Cho: I'll post step-by-step statuses in this thread during the window.
Morgan Li: noted. I'll escalate to phone if >5% mismatch or sustained lag. :thumbsup:
Alex Rivera: If no objections I'll schedule the runbook and calendar invite now.
Priya Nair: no objections from me — proceed.
Sam Cho: Ready to own smoke.
deploy-bot: Job db-7891 queued.
Alex Rivera: Pinning the runbook and leaving this thread as the single source of truth for the window.
